note: Known-answer task-quality tests. One test per service, run on the response of every paid call. Result is pass, fail, or not_graded. A paid call that settles but fails its test is a failed receipt. Services marked facts_only are broken on the seller's side at the moment: we publish what happened, but we do not grade them or sort them against others. The facts_only flag is lifted by hand after a clean paid call.

onesource-erc20-balance.input: USDT balance of vitalik.eth (0xd8da...6045) on Ethereum
onesource-erc20-balance.pass_if: balance equals balanceOf from a free public Ethereum RPC at one of the 6 newest blocks when we check

exa-search.pass_if: at least 1 result URL on x402.org or github.com/coinbase/x402

you-search.pass_if: at least 1 result URL on x402.org or github.com/coinbase/x402
you-search.facts_only_reason: On 2026-09-30 the endpoint answered our x402 payment with a second HTTP 402 asking to pay again by another method (Tempo), so nothing was delivered.

tavily-search.pass_if: at least 1 result URL on x402.org or github.com/coinbase/x402
tavily-search.facts_only_reason: On 2026-09-30 the payment settled but the sample request was rejected (HTTP 422). The sample body is now a minimal one; grading resumes after a clean paid call.

x402atlas-web-search.pass_if: at least 1 result URL on x402.org or github.com/coinbase/x402

otto-crypto-news.pass_if: at least 5 items, each with a source URL; newest item under 3 h old (the listing says hourly)

apitoll-edgar-filings.pass_if: CIK 0000320193 and the latest 10-K filing date match SEC's free submissions API
apitoll-edgar-filings.facts_only_reason: On 2026-09-30 the endpoint was unreachable (TLS handshake failed), so no paid call was made.

oblique-paid-time.pass_if: epoch within 5 s of our clock while the request was open; ISO time and epoch agree

coingecko-onchain-pool-search.pass_if: a pool with WETH (0xC02a...6Cc2) as base token

glassnode-mvrv.pass_if: newest point at most 48 h old and value between 0.3 and 6 (sanity check only, the weakest test)

x402tap-weather.pass_if: temperature within 3 C of the free Open-Meteo current temperature for Austin, TX (fallback: US National Weather Service station KAUS)

massive-ticker-news.pass_if: every item tags AAPL; newest item at most 7 days old

x402scan-merchants.pass_if: non-empty, sorted by volume (total_amount, largest first), each entry has an address

x402atlas-ssl-check.pass_if: hostname match is true; expiry equals the certificate expiry in our own TLS handshake

brasil-dados-cambio.pass_if: USD/BRL equals the free BCB PTAX API for that date
brasil-dados-cambio.facts_only_reason: On 2026-09-30 the endpoint answered our x402 payment with HTTP 500 and no data (no settlement transaction was reported).
